Players Committee card image of [[CT-5385 (Tup)]] (original printing), game text: “During any move phase, may fire a weapon at an Undercover spy. Permanent weapon is Clone Snipe Rifle (may target a character or vehicle for free; target hit if destiny +2 > defense value).”

The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
